Container.Name: bookwarden
Container.Overview:
Checks every book in your Calibre library against the files and national-library records, and applies only the fixes you approve, through Calibre's content server. On first start the container log shows a one-time setup code.
Networks: Bookwarden must reach your Calibre content server and a Postgres 18 database. On the default bridge network, use their LAN addresses (the Unraid server's IP and the port each container publishes). If they sit on custom Docker networks, add both networks at the end of Extra Parameters: --network <Calibre's network> --network <the database's network> (one --network if they share one). Unraid then ignores Network Type, and two networks need Docker 25 or newer. Bookwarden can then reach both by container name.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: LAN port for the web UI.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: postgres://bookwarden:PASSWORD@HOST:5432/bookwarden, where HOST is the Postgres container's name on a shared network or the server's LAN address. Use letters and digits only in the password.

Config.Name: Calibre URL
Config.Description: Calibre content server as this container reaches it: http://CONTAINER-NAME:8081 on a shared network, or http://LAN-IP:PORT.

Config.Name: Calibre user
Config.Description: Calibre account for bookwarden. Keep it read-only until you turn on fixes.

Config.Name: Calibre library
Config.Description: Library id. Empty means the server's default library.

Config.Name: Allowed hosts
Config.Description: Comma-separated host names or IPs you open bookwarden by, without ports, such as the server's LAN IP.

Config.Name: Hardcover API token
Config.Description: Optional. Hardcover records are saved with each check but don't change any decision yet.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Only with a reverse proxy in front: its IP addresses or CIDRs, no wider than /16 (or /48 for IPv6).

Config.Name: Metrics token
Config.Description: Optional bearer token that enables /metrics, at least 32 characters.

Config.Name: Incremental check schedule
Config.Description: Optional daily time (HH:MM, container TZ) for an incremental check that reuses unchanged files' evidence. Empty = off.

Config.Name: Full check schedule
Config.Description: Optional weekly full check, e.g. 'sun 04:00' (container TZ). On that day it replaces the incremental check. Empty = off.

Config.Name: Runs to keep
Config.Description: How many recent runs keep their evidence; runs with decisions or operations are always kept. 0 = keep all.

Config.Name: Heartbeat URL
Config.Description: Optional Uptime Kuma push monitor URL (http://host:3001/api/push/TOKEN). After each run Bookwarden reports up or down to it. Contains a secret token.

Config.Name: Heartbeat allowed addresses
Config.Description: Exact addresses the heartbeat may dial, e.g. <kuma-ip>/32. Needed for plain http or a private address.

Config.Name: Stop grace
Config.Description: How long a stop waits for the book in hand and a write in progress. Must be at least 5 s below the container's stop timeout (--stop-timeout 30 in the extra parameters), so raise both together.
